name: Monument
detailed_description:
About:

Monument is an immersive survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world inspired by The Walking Dead, Project Zomboid, and DayZ.

Navigate a ruthless world filled with zombies, hostile survivors, and limited resources. Every choice, whether you’re on your own or with others, will determine if you live or die. Build shelter, scavenge what you can, and fight off relentless threats day and night.

Features:

  • Dynamic Open World
    Explore a vast world with changing weather, day and night cycles and survival challenges.

  • Realistic Survival Mechanics
    Manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, health and other statistics.

  • Base Building and Fortifying
    Construct shelters and strengthen defences to survive against the world’s dangers.

  • Crafting System
    Gather resources and craft tools, weapons, and supplies to stay alive.

  • Monuments
    Explore monuments, remnants of a lost civilization, for valuable loot and secrets. Be cautious though, others may have the same idea.

  • Combat and Stealth
    Survive fierce combat or use stealth to avoid danger when supplies are scarce.

Modes:

  • Singleplayer
    Survive alone in a harsh, unforgiving world. Scavenge, build, and fight to stay alive, with every decision weighing heavily on your chances of survival.

  • Multiplayer
    Team up with friends to face the dangers of the world together. Work on crafting, base building, and defence as you fend off zombies and hostile survivors. Survival is easier with teamwork, but trust is scarce.

Lore:

The world once thrived, but a deadly virus soon swept across the globe, turning most of humanity into mindless, undead creatures. Civilization crumbled, and cities fell silent as the dead roamed the streets. What remained of society fractured into factions, each fighting for survival. Trust became a rare commodity, and the few survivors who remain are left to scavenge the ruins.

Scattered across the land are monuments, remnants of the old world, holding secrets of what happened and perhaps even a glimmer of hope. But in this harsh new reality, every choice is life or death. Now, you must navigate this unforgiving world, where the living may be more dangerous than the dead, and every moment counts in the struggle to survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K @ 3.3GHz / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280X (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Low settings, 1080p, 30 FPS
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (6GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX®-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Ultra settings, 1080p, 60 FPS+

content_descriptors.notes: Monument features mature content that includes violence, blood, and gore. Players will encounter depictions of zombie deaths with graphic blood and gore. The characters in the game are nude but do not have genitalia or explicit sexual content. While there is no explicit sexual content, the game's themes may include intense survival scenarios and psychological stress that could be unsettling for some players. Please be advised that the game includes scenes of violence and themes of survival in a harsh post-apocalyptic world.
